summary: Stop Qwen3.8-Flash-Next MTP responses from switching to a repeated token under async scheduling
details: With MTP and async scheduling, the next step could rewrite a step's prefill flags before their non-blocking host-to-device copy ran; QSA then read the wrong flags and the response continued as one token repeated. Both prefill-flag buffers are pageable, so each copy is staged through fresh pinned memory.
GLM-5.3-Flash's pooled-selector prefill flags had the same pattern and use the same change; no GLM-5.3-Flash failure had been reproduced.
